005package org.wpilib.command3;
006
007import static org.wpilib.util.ErrorMessages.requireNonNullParam;
008
009import java.util.Arrays;
010import java.util.Collection;
011import java.util.HashSet;
012import java.util.Objects;
013import java.util.Set;
014import java.util.function.BooleanSupplier;
015import java.util.function.Consumer;
016import org.wpilib.annotation.NoDiscard;
017
018/**
019 * A builder class for commands. Command configuration is done in stages, where later stages have
020 * different configuration options than earlier stages. Commands may only be created after going
021 * through every stage, enforcing the presence of required options. All commands <i>must</i> have a
022 * set of requirements (which may be empty), a name, and an implementation. The builder stages are
023 * defined such that the final stage that creates a command can only be reached after going through
024 * the earlier stages to configure those required options.
025 *
026 * <p>Example usage:
027 *
028 * <pre>{@code
029 * StagedCommandBuilder start = new StagedCommandBuilder();
030 * NeedsExecutionBuilderStage withRequirements = start.requiring(mechanism1, mechanism2);
031 * NeedsNameBuilderStage withExecution = withRequirements.executing(coroutine -> ...);
032 * Command exampleCommand = withExecution.named("Example Command");
033 * }</pre>
034 *
035 * <p>Because every method on the builders returns a builder object, these calls can be chained to
036 * cut down on verbosity and make the code easier to read. This is the recommended style:
037 *
038 * <pre>{@code
039 * Command exampleCommand =
040 *   new StagedCommandBuilder()
041 *     .requiring(mechanism1, mechanism2)
042 *     .executing(coroutine -> ...)
043 *     .named("Example Command");
044 * }</pre>
045 *
046 * <p>And can be cut down even further by using helper methods provided by the library:
047 *
048 * <pre>{@code
049 * Command exampleCommand =
050 *   Command
051 *     .requiring(mechanism1, mechanism2)
052 *     .executing(coroutine -> ...)
053 *     .named("Example Command");
054 * }</pre>
055 */
056@NoDiscard
057public final class StagedCommandBuilder {
058  private final Set<Mechanism> m_requirements = new HashSet<>();
059  private Consumer<Coroutine> m_impl;
060  private Runnable m_onCancel = () -> {};
061  private String m_name;
062  private int m_priority = Command.DEFAULT_PRIORITY;
063  private BooleanSupplier m_endCondition;
064
065  private Command m_builtCommand;
066
067  // Using internal anonymous classes to implement the staged builder APIs, but all backed by the
068  // state of the enclosing StagedCommandBuilder object
069
070  private final NeedsExecutionBuilderStage m_needsExecutionView =
071      new NeedsExecutionBuilderStage() {
072        @Override
073        public NeedsExecutionBuilderStage requiring(Mechanism requirement) {
074          throwIfAlreadyBuilt();
075
076          requireNonNullParam(requirement, "requirement", "StagedCommandBuilder.requiring");
077          m_requirements.add(requirement);
078          return this;
079        }
080
081        @Override
082        public NeedsExecutionBuilderStage requiring(Mechanism requirement, Mechanism... extra) {
083          throwIfAlreadyBuilt();
084
085          requireNonNullParam(requirement, "requirement", "StagedCommandBuilder.requiring");
086          requireNonNullParam(extra, "extra", "StagedCommandBuilder.requiring");
087
088          for (int i = 0; i < extra.length; i++) {
089            requireNonNullParam(extra[i], "extra[" + i + "]", "StagedCommandBuilder.requiring");
090          }
091
092          m_requirements.add(requirement);
093          m_requirements.addAll(Arrays.asList(extra));
094          return this;
095        }
096
097        @Override
098        public NeedsExecutionBuilderStage requiring(Collection<Mechanism> requirements) {
099          throwIfAlreadyBuilt();
100
101          requireNonNullParam(requirements, "requirements", "StagedCommandBuilder.requiring");
102          int i = 0;
103          for (Mechanism requirement : requirements) {
104            requireNonNullParam(
105                requirement, "requirements[" + i + "]", "StagedCommandBuilder.requiring");
106            i++;
107          }
108
109          m_requirements.addAll(requirements);
110          return this;
111        }
112
113        @Override
114        public NeedsNameBuilderStage executing(Consumer<Coroutine> impl) {
115          throwIfAlreadyBuilt();
116
117          requireNonNullParam(impl, "impl", "StagedCommandBuilder.executing");
118          m_impl = impl;
119          return m_needsNameView;
120        }
121      };
122
123  private final NeedsNameBuilderStage m_needsNameView =
124      new NeedsNameBuilderStage() {
125        @Override
126        public NeedsNameBuilderStage whenCanceled(Runnable onCancel) {
127          throwIfAlreadyBuilt();
128
129          m_onCancel = onCancel;
130          return this;
131        }
132
133        @Override
134        public NeedsNameBuilderStage withPriority(int priority) {
135          throwIfAlreadyBuilt();
136
137          m_priority = priority;
138          return this;
139        }
140
141        @Override
142        public NeedsNameBuilderStage until(BooleanSupplier endCondition) {
143          throwIfAlreadyBuilt();
144
145          m_endCondition = endCondition; // allowed to be null
146          return this;
147        }
148
149        @Override
150        public Command named(String name) {
151          throwIfAlreadyBuilt();
152
153          requireNonNullParam(name, "name", "StagedCommandBuilder.withName");
154          m_name = name;
155
156          var command = new BuilderBackedCommand(StagedCommandBuilder.this);
157
158          if (m_endCondition == null) {
159            // No custom end condition, just return the raw command
160            m_builtCommand = command;
161          } else {
162            // A custom end condition is implemented as a race group, since we cannot modify the
163            // command body to inject the end condition.
164            m_builtCommand =
165                new ParallelGroupBuilder().requiring(command).until(m_endCondition).named(m_name);
166          }
167
168          return m_builtCommand;
169        }
170      };
171
172  private static final class BuilderBackedCommand implements Command {
173    private static final Runnable NO_OP = () -> {};
174
175    private final Set<Mechanism> m_requirements;
176    private final Consumer<Coroutine> m_impl;
177    private final Runnable m_onCancel;
178    private final String m_name;
179    private final int m_priority;
180
181    private BuilderBackedCommand(StagedCommandBuilder builder) {
182      // Copy builder fields into the command so the builder object can be garbage collected
183      m_requirements = new HashSet<>(builder.m_requirements);
184      m_impl = builder.m_impl;
185      m_onCancel = Objects.requireNonNullElse(builder.m_onCancel, NO_OP);
186      m_name = builder.m_name;
187      m_priority = builder.m_priority;
188    }
189
190    @Override
191    public void run(Coroutine coroutine) {
192      m_impl.accept(coroutine);
193    }
194
195    @Override
196    public void onCancel() {
197      m_onCancel.run();
198    }
199
200    @Override
201    public String name() {
202      return m_name;
203    }
204
205    @Override
206    public Set<Mechanism> requirements() {
207      return m_requirements;
208    }
209
210    @Override
211    public int priority() {
212      return m_priority;
213    }
214
215    @Override
216    public String toString() {
217      return name();
218    }
219  }
220
221  /**
222   * Creates a new command builder. All required options must be set on each stage before a command
223   * is able to be created. Attempting to create a command without setting all required options will
224   * result in a compilation error.
225   */
226  public StagedCommandBuilder() {}
227
228  /**
229   * Explicitly marks the command as requiring no mechanisms. Unless overridden later with {@link
230   * NeedsExecutionBuilderStage#requiring(Mechanism)} or a similar method, the built command will
231   * not have ownership over any mechanisms when it runs. Use this for commands that don't need to
232   * own a mechanism, such as a gyro zeroing command, that does some kind of cleanup task without
233   * needing to control something.
234   *
235   * @return A builder object that can be used to further configure the command.
236   */
237  public NeedsExecutionBuilderStage noRequirements() {
238    throwIfAlreadyBuilt();
239
240    return m_needsExecutionView;
241  }
242
243  /**
244   * Marks the command as requiring one or more mechanisms. If only a single mechanism is required,
245   * prefer a factory function like {@link Mechanism#run(Consumer)} or similar - it will
246   * automatically require the mechanism, instead of it needing to be explicitly specified.
247   *
248   * @param requirement The first required mechanism. Cannot be null.
249   * @param extra Any optional extra required mechanisms. May be empty, but cannot be null or
250   *     contain null values.
251   * @return A builder object that can be used to further configure the command.
252   */
253  public NeedsExecutionBuilderStage requiring(Mechanism requirement, Mechanism... extra) {
254    throwIfAlreadyBuilt();
255
256    requireNonNullParam(requirement, "requirement", "StagedCommandBuilder.requiring");
257    requireNonNullParam(extra, "extra", "StagedCommandBuilder.requiring");
258
259    for (int i = 0; i < extra.length; i++) {
260      requireNonNullParam(extra[i], "extra[" + i + "]", "StagedCommandBuilder.requiring");
261    }
262
263    m_requirements.add(requirement);
264    m_requirements.addAll(Arrays.asList(extra));
265    return m_needsExecutionView;
266  }
267
268  /**
269   * Marks the command as requiring zero or more mechanisms. If only a single mechanism is required,
270   * prefer a factory function like {@link Mechanism#run(Consumer)} or similar - it will
271   * automatically require the mechanism, instead of it needing to be explicitly specified.
272   *
273   * @param requirements A collection of required mechanisms. May be empty, but cannot be null or
274   *     contain null values.
275   * @return A builder object that can be used to further configure the command.
276   */
277  public NeedsExecutionBuilderStage requiring(Collection<Mechanism> requirements) {
278    throwIfAlreadyBuilt();
279
280    requireNonNullParam(requirements, "requirements", "StagedCommandBuilder.requiring");
281    int i = 0;
282    for (var mechanism : requirements) {
283      requireNonNullParam(mechanism, "requirements[" + i + "]", "StagedCommandBuilder.requiring");
284      i++;
285    }
286
287    m_requirements.addAll(requirements);
288    return m_needsExecutionView;
289  }
290
291  // Prevent builders from being mutated after command creation
292  // Weird things could happen like changing requirements, priority level, or even the command
293  // implementation itself if we didn't prohibit it.
294  private void throwIfAlreadyBuilt() {
295    if (m_builtCommand != null) {
296      throw new IllegalStateException("Command builders cannot be reused");
297    }
298  }
299}
